description: SHIMMER compiles gas-network component information and hydrogen-material compatibility evidence. It includes pipeline, valve, fitting, gasket and compressor information supplied by participating operators, alongside literature and regulatory summaries. The provider is SHIMMER consortium and participating gas operators. Coverage: The provider reports 43,195 kilometres of pipelines from selected European transmission and distribution operators. Coverage is partial and varies between transmission and distribution assets. Access: The project publishes structured categories and data links through its database page. Component tables were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The sample covers a limited share of European pipes. Traffic-light compatibility categories summarise evidence and do not certify individual components or operating conditions. For simulation it can inform material classes, retrofit assumptions and the traceable source of hydrogen-compatibility constraints. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
